name: distro-tailor
description: Adaptive 20-questions Linux selector and custom distro recipe generator
author: DistroTailor Community

scripts.build: npm run -w @distro-tailor/core build && npm run -w @distro-tailor/cli build && npm run -w @distro-tailor/web build
scripts.test: npm run --workspaces --if-present test && tsx --test 'scripts/**/*.test.ts' && npm run scoring:check
